answer: Cross-Cluster Co-Activity Audit. Build a graph of which identities transact with the same rare counterparties or resources; sybil clusters show anomalously dense overlap compared to a cedar of organic ties. Flag clusters whose internal coherence exceeds a threshold, then require each flagged identity to pass a fresh independent challenge. An attacker must spread across many clusters and sustain genuine-looking diversity, raising per-identity cost well above the reward, while honest agents wander freely and a few false flags wash out on the reef of appeals.
